provenance: Three of the development jobs of the b16 layer step (amendment A7, section 14) ran on logical processors 8 and 10 while a record pass was timed on 2 and 4: the hotpotqa job (22:54 to 22:59 IST, 4 Nov) beside hotpotqa's BLAS-2 pass, the musique job (22:59 to 23:04) beside hotpotqa's BLAS-1 pass, and the 2wiki job (23:14 to 23:20) beside musique's BLAS-2 pass, whose whole timed region it covered; the other three passes ran with no such job. A noise read, made after the passes and decided by no rule, found no slowdown beside those jobs: stage (a), the same code in M3 and M5, has a p50 of 133.9 ms in musique's BLAS-2 pass against 141.4 in its BLAS-1 pass (no job beside it) and 142.7 in M3; the drift between the halves of that pass in model-only p50 (MLP 83 to 76 ms, GNN 120 to 110) is the drift of the BLAS-1 pass (84 to 79, 117 to 109), common to both models; and the ratios of the two halves agree (cold forward 3.91 and 3.86, end to end 1.160 and 1.175). No pass was rerun. The b16 columns here are the module's layer step on the batches of 16; amendment A7's re-time replaces them where its checks pass. This note was added after the generator ran.
